selectionEntries.name: Cryptothralls
selectionEntries.comment: PHASE 0.1 COMPILER NOTE: CRYPTOTHRALLS are printed in the PDF's Leaders section but their datasheet is Infantry, not Leader. They are displayed under Leader for presentation only, do not consume Leader capacity, and do not receive the generic Other 1/2/3 copy limit. Their only roster legality is the required-attached-by rule.
